C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.economic_unit: the paired closure-week; adjacent-week and regime dependence acknowledged and handled by blocking
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.pairing: identical closure weeks, identical seed-only action tapes, identical windows across every cell of a family and every seed
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.differentials: per-closure-week paired net-return-after-costs differentials versus the comparator cell
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.inference: stationary block bootstrap (Politis-Romano) over closure weeks, expected block length 4 weeks, 10000 resamples; per-seed week series are aggregated hierarchically to week level FIRST; seed dispersion is reported separately from market-time uncertainty and never enters the week-level SE
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.minimum_support: at least 30 eligible closure-weeks in fit/calibration, else INCONCLUSIVE — never a winner
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.precision_rule: a selection requires the bootstrap 90% CI half-width of the winning differential to be at most half its point estimate; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.selection_and_evaluation: W1 selects on fit/calibration only, freezes ONE timing, and is evaluated on a later untouched decision window; W2a begins only after that freeze and W2b only after W2a, each with its own calibration/decision separation; no dataset both chooses and judges its winner
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.family_level_procedure: Hansen SPA with the same stationary bootstrap over each full family (16 W1 / 45 W2a / 27 W2b) against the section-4 default cell; Holm-Bonferroni retained as descriptive only, never as the selection correction
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.tie_rule: ties within ONE stationary-bootstrap SE of the closure-week differential (hierarchical, never seed-level) resolve toward larger wind_down_hours then larger forced_flatten_hours (W1) and toward the longer blackout (W2a)
C7_statistical_protocol_v2_predeclared.trial_ledger: all 93 materialized cells are recorded trials; any cell ever attempted stays in the ledger

proposed_sac_preflight_NOT_LAUNCHED.purpose: measure SAC update throughput so compute estimates stop being parametric guesses
proposed_sac_preflight_NOT_LAUNCHED.shape: ONE cell (w0_overlay_enabled), ONE seed, CPU only, <= 20000 env steps and <= 20000 SAC updates, wall-clock bounded at 2 hours, config digest persisted before execution, observable and stoppable per runtime order 95e088da
proposed_sac_preflight_NOT_LAUNCHED.returns: env steps/s and SAC updates/s separately, peak memory, and the resulting staged W0/W1/W2a estimates
proposed_sac_preflight_NOT_LAUNCHED.authorization: requires Musashi's independent acceptance before launch
